messages:
mika: thinking out loud — propose a 'closure sprintlet' pattern for postmortem followups. super-light, same-day, focused on locking an owner + quick ETA to stop drift :hourglass_flowing_sand:
owen: curious — how is this different from our 72h postmortem and the micro followups we've discussed?
mika: 72h = full narrative. sprintlet = a 1-paragraph action commit created before IC hands off. goal is to close small remediations within 7 days
fatima: ok example please, makes it sticky for ICs
mika: pasteable block:
```
CLOSURE SPRINTLET (one-paragraph)
- Owner: @owner
- Commit: single-sentence remediation (what will change)
- Target: N business days (e.g. 7d)
- Risk: recurrence low/med/high
- Blockers: short list
- Check: auto-ping +72h, manual update on milestone
```
riley: rotation rule idea — IC creates sprintlet and @assigns owner before end-of-shift. if owner not found, IC assigns squad oncall as interim and files the sprintlet on remediation board
owen: ops ask — can we classify sprintlets on the board as 'short' vs 'long' so capacity planning ignores them in the weekly backlog sweep?
mika: yes, board tags: short/long. short = sprintlet with <=7d target
inc-bot: Note: current policy requires postmortem draft within 72h for Sev2+. Closure sprintlet is an optional rapid-tracking mechanism. inc-bot can file and tag sprintlets in the remediation board if configured (eng-sre setup required)
fatima: propose comms template for stakeholders: one-line status + ETA + owner, e.g. "Mitigation committed, owner @x, estimated done in 3 business days." Keeps execs happy without extra noise
riley: suggest automatic reminders: inc-bot ping @owner at +72h and +7d if still open. also add a weekly digest of sprintlets older than 7d for the remediation council
owen: I'll add a tiny checkbox to the incident runbook so ICs don't forget to create sprintlet (if remediation fits)
mika: next steps: 1) add sprintlet block to incident KB (mika) 2) add sprintlet checkbox to runbook and PM template (owen) 3) inc-bot sprintlet filing + reminders (riley) 4) pilot on next rotation (fatima)
fatima: taking pilot coordination, will run during Friday IC and collect examples
riley: will prototype inc-bot filing and reminder workflow, ETA 4 days
owen: updating runbook and template now, will PR for review
mika: small change but should shrink ownership latency and make recurring patterns easier to spot. we can measure by number of sprintlets closed within target and time-to-first-owner :chart_with_upwards_trend:
